title: Phase I/II trial of meclofenamate in progressive MGMT-methylated glioblastoma under temozolomide second-line therapy (MecMeth/ NOA-24)
official: Phase I/II trial of meclofenamate in progressive MGMT-methylated glioblastoma under temozolomide second-line therapy (MecMeth/ NOA-24)
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of Phase I is to determine toxicity of meclofenamate sodium therapy in addition to standard temozolomide and, on this base, determine the daily meclofenamate sodium dose to be recommended for Phase II. In Phase II, the primary objective is efficacy of meclofenamate sodium therapy in addition to standard therapy.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. 1. First relapse after first-line therapy with radiotherapy (RT) and alkylating chemotherapy, ≥ 3 months after last chemotherapy application and >6 months after end of RT. Drug therapy and/or radiotherapy for first relapse treatment not yet started.
2. 10. Adequate liver function (bilirubin <1.5 x ULN; ASAT /ALAT <3 x ULN, creat-inine < 1.5 x ULN
3. 11. Patient compliance that allows adequate follow up
4. 12. Male and female patients with reproductive potential must use an ap-proved contraceptive method during and for 3 months after the trial (Pearl index <1%)
5. 13. Pre-menopausal female patients with childbearing potential: a negative serum pregnancy test (beta-HCG) must be obtained prior to treatment start
6. Addition criterion for Phase II only: 14. Resection at first relapse not yet performed; according to the local treating neurosurgeon and the documented decision of local neurooncological tu-mor board, reresection of the tumor is clinically indicated and can be safe-ly deferred until day 7-10 after initiation of MFA/TMZ therapy
7. 2. Tumor progression according to RANO criteria
8. 3. Written informed consent
9. 4. Cognitive state to understand rationale and necessity of study therapy and procedures
10. 5. MGMT promotor-methylated (MGMTmeth), IDH wildtype glioblastoma (GBM) or gliosarcoma confirmed with histology of the primary resection or, in phase II, last resection
11. 6. Age > 18 years
12. 7. Karnofsky performance score (KPS) ≥50%;
13. 8. Life expectancy > 6 months
14. 9. Adequate bone marrow reserve (WBC >3 G/nl, platelets >100 G/nl
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Indication for hematotoxicity in first-line therapy not allowing TMZ starting dose 150 mg/m2/d at the discretion of the investigator
2. 10. Breastfeeding or pregnant
3. 11. Unable to undergo contrast-enhanced MRI (i.e. contrast allergy, implants, etc
4. 12. Treatment in another clinical trial with therapeutic medical intervention or use of any other investigational agent during the trial or within the 30 days before enrollment
5. 13. Medication with a drug that is not allowed in conjunction with MFA intake and cannot be discontinued: i.e. lithium, methotrexate, etc
6. 14. Patients with active bleeding, bleeding diathesis, antiplatelet therapy or anticoagulant therapy  except for the following anticoagulants which are permitted for low-dose thrombosis prophylaxis up to the dosage speci-fied here: unfractionated heparin 7,500 IU BID or 5,000 IU TID; low molecu-lar weight heparin e. g. enoxaparin 40 mg/d; fondaparinux 2.5 mg/d; danaparoid sodium 750 IU BID; argatroban IV route thrombin time < 70 s; dabigatran 110 mg BID; rivaroxaban 10 mg/d; edoxaban 30 mg/d; epixa-ban 2.5 mg BID  This restriction is due to a potentially increased risk of GI ulcers with subsequent bleeding under MFA therapy. (Not applicable for Phase II)
7. 15. Patients with medically diagnosed hereditary Galactose Intolerance, com-plete lactase deficiency or confirmed Glucose-Galactose-Malabsorption
8. 16. Medical History of gastrointestinal Resection of any kind that may poten-tially alter the absorption of the investigational study drug, according to investigators judgement
9. 17. The presence of any other concomitant severe, progressive, or uncon-trolled renal, hepatic, hematological, endocrine, pulmonary, cardiac (in-cluding coronary artery bypass graft), or psychiatric disease, or signs and symptoms thereof, that may affect the subjects participation in the study, according to investigators judgement
10. 2. History of temozolomide-related liver toxicity > CTCAE5 grade 1 or skin toxicity > CTCAE5 grade 2 in first-line therapy
11. 3. History of gastrointestinal bleeding or gastroduodenal ulcer, active gastritis
12. 4. History of NSAID-related asthma, urticaria or allergic-type skin reactions
13. 5. Uncontrolled malignancy within the last 2 years
14. 6. History of confirmed or suspected hypersensitivity (delayed type and im-mediate type, inclusive of anaphylactic reaction) to any background/ standard  TMZ drug product or one of its ingredients of the chosen prod-uct, or to cyclooxygenase inhibitors (“NSAIDs”), or to any ingredient of meclofenamate drug product
15. 7. History of other disease with poor prognosis
16. 8. History of severe coronary heart disease (esp. after coronary artery bypass graft or  history of myocardial infarction)or severe heart failure
17. 9. Known HIV infection, active hepatitis B or C
